summary: Before rebasing, make sure origin points to your fork and add an upstream remote for the main repository, using ansible/ansible as the example.
questions: How do I add the upstream remote for ansible/ansible?
What remotes do I need before rebasing my PR?

answer_card.title: Configure remotes for rebasing
answer_card.answer_md:
`origin` should point to your fork. Add upstream:
```shell-session
$ git remote add upstream https://github.com/ansible/ansible.git
$ git remote -v
```
You should see both `origin` (your fork) and `upstream`. Branch names may differ in other repos.
